lesson.title: Line up decimal units
lesson.subtitle: P4 decimal revision
lesson.objective: Add or subtract decimals using equal place units.
lesson.story: Calculate with equal place units and check the result.

steps.title: Choose equal units
steps.prompt: How should the decimal places line up?

choices.label: Subtract digits without checking their place values.
Line up decimal points so each place matches the same place.
Line up the last written digits even when their places differ.

hints: Start with the meaning of the decimal places.
Ones match ones, tenths match tenths and hundredths match hundredths.
A missing decimal digit can be written as zero to match places.
Choose the explanation that lines up matching decimal places.

steps.title: Calculate with decimals
hints: Look at the units before calculating.
Line up the decimal points to match equal units.
Exchange one whole for ten tenths so there are enough tenths to subtract. Then subtract matching places.

steps.title: Explain the equal units
steps.prompt: What helps us calculate with decimals?

choices.label: Use equal place units and check the relationship.
A decimal point means we can ignore any zero places.
The number of written digits always tells us the value.

hints: Tenths and hundredths are different-sized units.
A relationship only works when we use the matching units.
Choose: Use equal place units and check the relationship.
